about.title: About me
about.body1: I'm Carlos Iván Perdomo, a Software Analysis and Development technologist in the final stage of my training. I design and build web applications with React, Node.js and MySQL, and desktop systems with Python and PyQt5 — understanding the business problem first, writing the code second.
about.body2: Before moving into development I spent 7 years reconciling and auditing daily financial records, where a discrepancy could not wait until the next day. That's where my rigor with data and my habit of verifying before calling something done come from: today it shows up as transactions with rollback so stock never drifts, and as 63 automated tests covering my API.
about.body3: I keep learning continuously: I read technical documentation in English, work with current tooling like React 19, Vite and Jest, and strengthen my foundations in Python, JavaScript and databases. Staying current isn't optional; it's part of the craft.
